flags.why: Hắc does not mean wearing an expression of extreme pain; its established senses concern pungency, strictness, difficulty and an imposing appearance. [Dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-h%E1%BA%AFc)
The fruit-ripeness usage, especially in me dốt, is Southern and needs a regional label. [Usage](https://voer.edu.vn/m/cay-me/1ac61d7c)

Khăm describes concealed nastiness and is not a countable noun meaning a dirty trick, so một cái khăm teaches a false usage. [Dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-kh%C4%83m)
Ăn hiếp is chiefly Southern usage and lacks the corresponding regional warning. [Nam Bộ dictionary](https://dokumen.pub/tu-dien-tu-ngu-nam-bo.html)
Nhái means a small frog generally, rather than having a separate meaning specifically identifying a tree frog. [Dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-nh%C3%A1i)

The road-divider meaning, usually expressed as con lươn, remains ordinary colloquial usage and is misleadingly tagged rare. [Current usage](https://hongmen.com.vn/tin-tuc/tin-tuc-khac/con-luon-tren-duong-la-gi-dai-phan-cach-hongmen.html)
